# packages

Stores **auto-generated** typed client SDKs derived from `contracts/runtime-api/openapi.yaml` during OpenSpec `002` (`CARD-004`):

- `runtime-sdk-rs/` — Consumed by `apps/cli`
- `runtime-sdk-go/` — Consumed by `apps/client2`
- `runtime-sdk-ts/` — Consumed by frontend views, plugins, and Playwright E2E suites

**NEVER edit generated files in this directory manually.**
